name: clear-stray-wrench-from-bench-grinder-tool-rest-before-powering-on
context: General Maintenance and Repair Workers (BLS SOC 49-9071: >1,500,000 workers) and Automotive Service Technicians and Mechanics (BLS SOC 49-3023: >700,000 workers; combined workforce >2.2M) operate 6-inch bench grinders daily for deburring, sharpening chisels/drills, and dressing metal workpieces. Under OSHA 1910.215 (Abrasive Wheel Machinery) and general machine shop safety protocols, energizing a 3,450 RPM bench grinder while an open-end/box combination wrench is left resting on the adjustable tool rest against or near the spinning vitrified abrasive wheel causes severe mechanical jamming, catastrophic wheel burst, and high-velocity projectile shrapnel toward the operator. Operators must routinely inspect the grinding zone, remove any foreign tools or obstructions from the tool rest to a designated side magnetic tool tray, and only then actuate the front electrical power switch.
setup: A commercial 6-inch tabletop bench grinder (cast iron motor housing 200 x 200 x 125 mm, twin wheel guards, right vitrified abrasive wheel 140 mm OD x 22 mm thick, adjustable steel tool rest at Z = 0.8175 m) sits firmly on the workbench centered at X = 0.300 m, Y = 0.000 m. A forged steel combination wrench (mass 0.045 kg, 140 mm length with ergonomic 45 mm diameter cylindrical grip collar) rests on the right tool rest at X = 0.300 m, Y = -0.165 m, Z = 0.8295 m, within 15 mm of the grinding wheel perimeter. An adjacent stamped steel tool staging tray (160 x 140 x 15 mm with raised border lips) is positioned on the right side at X = 0.300 m, Y = -0.260 m, Z = 0.7475 m. The front electrical power switch is a prominent red push-button switch in the OFF position at X = 0.195 m, Y = 0.000 m, Z = 0.7875 m. Station table surface at Z = 0.7475 m.
scoring: Current-state stage scoring with causal latch: 0.00 initial; 0.20 when the stray combination wrench is lifted clear (>45 mm above the tool rest, Z > 0.8625 m); 0.40 when the wrench is set down inside the side tool staging tray perimeter (XY distance <= 80 mm from tray center, Z < 0.7925 m, >90 mm clear of the grinding wheel); 0.75 when the front power push-button switch is depressed inward into the chassis (travel >= 8.0 mm); 1.00 when the power switch is actuated ON, the wrench rests stably inside the staging tray, and both robot arms retract clear (>=40 mm) for a 20-step (1.0 s at 20 Hz) stillness dwell hold. Irreversible 0.0 defect latch triggers if the power switch is depressed while the combination wrench remains on or within 65 mm of the grinding tool rest, or if the wrench falls off the workbench.
reset_notes: Return the steel combination wrench to the right tool rest at X = 0.300 m, Y = -0.165 m, Z = 0.8295 m. Reset the front power push-button switch to the OFF position (0 mm depression). Verify the staging tray is empty and both robot arms are parked clear.
fidelity: Authentic commercial 6-inch bench grinder geometry, tool rest dimensions (OSHA 1910.215 compliant 1/8-inch wheel gap), and mass distribution. Front power switch modeled as a prismatic slider joint with physical stroke resistance. Wrench modeled as a 100% genuine dynamic rigid body with cylindrical ergonomic collar for parallel jaw clamping. Causal defect latch strictly enforces OSHA 1910.215 machine guarding and anti-projectile safety rules.
